review_description: Sam was very helpful with choosing the best system. His team were very dedicated and did their best on the installation day!
Sam has been brilliant - very responsive, helpful, and followed through on every action. Highly recommended.

Sam made the sales/quote process easy and recognised I’d done my research and asked what I wanted from a solar system. He was open and flexible about cost and product.The installation proved a little more complicated than we first thought but a great team of Tradie’s worked tirelessly to get the job done. They were punctual, professional, polite and cleaned up after the system was in.After sales service had been great too. They organised the grid connection and educated me on how to use the app.Very happy to highly recommend Sine Wave to anyone wanting a first class system and installation.

Received three quotes from SolarQuotes-recommended contractors and ultimately chose Sinwave Solar.The quoting process was smooth and professional. The team took the time to understand my needs and preferences, offering three well-considered options. They were responsive to my feedback, adjusting the final proposal without hesitation to ensure the system met my exact requirements. Throughout the process, their focus was on delivering a solution that suited me, with no pressure or complications.As a former electrical contractor, I paid close attention to the quality and safety of the installation. This was a key factor in my decision, as I wanted a system that was not only efficient but also installed to the highest standard. Sinwave Solar exceeded my expectations—their workmanship was excellent, they used high-quality materials, and they took great care of my property. They also kept me informed throughout the installation, consulting me on all key aspects for my approval.If you're looking for a high-quality solar installation tailored to your specific needs, I highly recommend Sinwave Solar. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering a top-tier solution make them an excellent choice.
Super easy process..Professional helpful advice and great communication ..Arrived on time and installed and checked promptly..Follow up calls to check on us appreciated

Sam came out and talked me through the process and answered any concerns re the install I had. Not a standard job but Sam solved the problems so the connection was able to go smoothly. Would highly recommend  Sine Wave Solar
Sam was very helpful and informative.  Punctual appointment and quotes. Installation went smoothly and is assisting with sorting an issue with our retailer.

We were extremely happy working with Sam and the team at Sine Wave Solar and Electrical throughout the process of quoting, discussions and installation of our solar panels. Sam provided us with alot of information and various options to consider. Highly recommend this local business.

Sam and the team were excellent from the first contact to the completion of installation. Would high recommend to anyone in the area.After sales service is very important to us and we are comforted by the fact that Sine Wave will be monitoring our system for the next 10 years.
